name: curtain-length
description: Verify the curtain length toggle: floor-to-ceiling vs sill-length (hem stops just below the window sill). Placed side by side in open floor and viewed head-on.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-two-lengths
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; s.setItems([ {id:'c-floor',defId:'curtains',position:[cx-1.3,cz],rotation:0,props:{width:1.6,height:2.6,color:'#9c6b4f',drawAmount:1,length:'floor',sillY:0.9}}, {id:'c-sill',defId:'curtains',position:[cx+1.3,cz],rotation:0,props:{width:1.6,height:2.6,color:'#5f7a8c',drawAmount:1,length:'sill',sillY:0.9}} ]); window.__row={cx,cz}; })()
